semiconductor_relevance: High — Sensesemi Technologies specializes in System-on-a-Chip (SoC) solutions for IoT and IoMT applications, which are integral to the semiconductor industry.
summary: Sensesemi Technologies Pvt Ltd develops advanced System-on-a-Chip (SoC) solutions aimed at revolutionizing the Connected Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) and Internet of Things (IoT). Their products focus on ultra-low energy consumption and embedded AI, catering to the growing demand for connected devices.
